answer: You could make a simple and healthy meal like a Spinach and Rice Stir-Fry with Eggs. Start by cooking the rice and setting it aside. In a pan, cook the eggs scrambled or fried, then add the spinach and stir-fry it for a few minutes until wilted. Serve the cooked rice alongside the stir-fried mixture for a balanced and satisfying dinner.
